descriptionChirho: An outer garment, mantle, or cloak worn as clothing; the standard sense of שִׂמְלָה referring to a piece of clothing draped or wrapped around the body.
A piece of cloth or wrapper used for carrying or bundling objects, as when the Israelites wrapped their kneading bowls in their שִׂמְלֹת (Exod 12:34) or Ruth carried barley in hers (Ruth 3:15).
